paragraphs: On Saturday morning, the Explorers went to a big sports shop in the town. The shop was big, and it was full of people. Teacher Kim wanted some equipment for the club. "We need a flashlight and two backpacks for the next trips," she said. Inside the shop, she asked a shop assistant, "Where is the camping area?" "Take the lift to the third floor," said the shop assistant. "Go straight on, and you will see the camping area beside the stairs."

First, the children took the lift to the third floor. Mia chose the third floor, and Leo counted the floors. They went straight on and found the camping area easily. A red tent stood in the middle of the floor. "The big tent is very expensive," said Lily. She wrote the price in her notebook. May counted six flashlights on the shelf.

Next, Teacher Kim chose a small flashlight and two cheap backpacks. "These are good for the club," she said. Then Leo pointed at a sign. It said, "Surfing: second floor, on the left." "Can we go there?" asked Leo. "Yes, but we will take the stairs," said Teacher Kim.

On the second floor, a long yellow board stood on the wall. A photo of big waves was next to it. Leo stood beside the board like a surfer, and he held his arms out. Mia took a photo of him, and everybody laughed. "Is surfing easy?" Leo asked a shop assistant. "No, it is hard," she said, "but it is fun." "The sea is far from here," said Teacher Kim. "But you can learn about it, and you can write about it."

After that, the club walked to the park next to the shop. The sun was warm, and the grass was soft. They ate lunch on the grass. Leo sat on a swing, and Mia pushed him slowly. Finally, the bus came, and everybody went home. That evening, Lily wrote a post for the club blog. She wrote, "Today we chose equipment for our trips." "We have a flashlight, two backpacks, and a surfing story."
